name: makeupstore.co.il
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But buttons must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain request; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome. Partial analysis: 19 of 19 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. makeupstore.co.il scores 71 out of 100 (C). 6 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: buttons must have discernible text.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /, for example .Modal__content > .ModalHeader__header.shop_1uv63n2_1shcul6 > .ModalHeader__button.shop_1lvdccn_1shcul6[type="button"]:n and .Modal__content > .ModalHeader__header.shop_1uv63n2_1shcul6 >…
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Form elements must have labels
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /, for example .TextInput__input. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 77 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The start page took 5118 ms to arrive
fix.evidence: That is the HTML alone, before images and scripts.
fix.fix: Cache the HTML at the edge, or speed up the server render.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The largest element paints in 0.9 s
Every page has a meta description
Language alternates point at each other
